_source: Sourcebook/Chapter 3 Character Origins/Roles/*.md, 'Dream' d6 tables (hand-verified against the role pages)
Captain: I want to be the king/queen of the pirates.
A pirate captain saved my life once and inspired me to take up the mantle myself until I can surpass them.
I want to create a pirate paradise where people can live a life of absolute freedom.
The world government is a scourge on the free world and must be torn down from its thrones.
I want to create a better world for everyone, free from aristocracy and oppression.
I will create the greatest armada that the world has ever seen.
Cook: There's a mythical sea called the "All Blue" where fish from all oceans swim. I want to find it one day.
I want to create the perfect dish.
I wish to master all 99 recipes of the so-called "Attack Cuisine".
There are so many strange, rare creatures in the world. I want to cook a meal with every ingredient possible.
I want to create my own restaurant that serves food that can't be found anywhere else.
There is a single, mythical ingredient somewhere in the world that no one has mastered. I will be the first.
Deckhand: I will do everything in my power to make sure my captain becomes the king/queen of the pirates.
One day, I want to be a legend sung about in songs of heroes.
I want to have the adventure of a lifetime!
I made a promise to a childhood friend to brave the seas, and I will keep that promise no matter what.
Noone believed me when I said I would sail around the world, and I aim to prove them all wrong.
There's a mythical island located somewhere in the New World that I want to see with my own eyes.
Doctor: An incurable disease is ravaging my homeland, and I aim to find a cure before it's too late.
I wish to create a miracle drug that can cure any illness or sickness.
I want to write my own encyclopedia on rare medical herbs and plants all over the world.
A doctor once gave their lives to save mine. I pursue my craft to make them proud.
I want to create a hospital somewhere that can take care of any patient, no matter the illness.
Honestly, I'm good if I can just keep my crew of idiots alive until we reach the next island.
Helmsman: One day, I will stand at the helm of a ship as it sails around the world.
I wish to master myself as I master the ship I command.
There is a legendary storm that no one has sailed through before. I will be the first to commandeer a ship through its waves.
I won't settle for a single ship, I want to sail all manners of ships!
I've heard legends of a ship that can sail the skies to the moon and back. I want to sail it myself.
There's a ship known to revolt against its crews. I will find it and tame it.
Master at Arms: My captain's dream is my dream, it will come true!
I will be the strongest fighter in the world!
I have a rival that I wasn't strong enough to defeat before. I must grow stronger to face them again one day.
I seek to master the art of fighting for the sake of someone else who cannot do so anymore.
I have learned of a secret technique no one has ever mastered. I will be the first one to do so.
Seeing my crew make it to the end of Grand Line is all I care about.
Musician: I left my sweetheart behind as I took to the seas. One day I will return to them with a treasure in my hands.
I wish to record the epic adventures of my crew and immortalize them through song.
Somewhere in the world, there is beauty unlike any other. I wish to lay my own eyes upon it at least once.
Notes on a great performance are scattered around the world. I want to collect them all and recreate them in their full glory.
I wish to bring the joy of laughter and song to all corners of the world.
I fell in love with someone who set off to sea, and now I follow their trail in hopes of a reunion.
Navigator: I wish to draw a map of the entire world.
There is a passage in the Grand Line said to be impossible to chart, and I aim to prove that wrong.
A legendary storm sweeps across the seas every 100 years. I aim to be the first one to conquer it.
A stranger gifted me a map of an ancient treasure, and I will not rest until I've found it.
I inherited an incomplete map of the New World and promised to finish what my predecessor started.
I wish to chart a trade route that will span from the depths of Fishman Island to the most distant sky islands.
Scholar: It's my duty to unravel the true history behind the Void Century.
I was gifted an ancient text that will lead to a great discovery, and I promised myself I'd find it.
The secrets of the past will unravel the world government, and that's exactly what I wish for.
I wish to find and control the ancient weapons of the world: Pluton, Poseidon, and Uranus.
I am currently working on a chronicle of the world's history, and I need to learn everything to complete it.
The knowledge of the poneglyphs must be preserved.
Shipwright: I wish to build a ship that can sail to the ends of the world and back again.
The ship of my dreams can fight off 10 galleons without a scratch in the hull.
I dream of revolutionizing the history of shipwrights by creating something no one has seen before.
Any ship can sail on water. I wish to build a ship that can sail the skies!
My mentor created a work of art but died before seeing it realized. I swore to make their dream a reality.
There exists a storm that no ship has conquered, and I intend to build the ship that could.
